notes.title: Playtest - Stability Improvements
notes.content:
[b]Stability & Save System Update[/b]
[i]Build playtest-57789[/i]

[b]Release Notes:[/b]
- [b]Save System[/b] – Adjusted save timing to prevent flow-breaking issues, especially after crashes.
- [b]Crash Fix[/b] – Resolved crash when ending a mission with enemies still present on the map.
- [b]Crash Fix[/b] – Fixed crash when returning to Main Menu during the Crater Boss fight.
- [b]Softlock Fix[/b] – Fixed elevator softlock triggered by dying before an activity starts due to the “Overheat Drain” perk (reported by Bismuth).
- [b]Perk Update[/b] – Reworked mutated perk “Overheat Drain” into a new version: [i]“Watch them BURN!”[/i]
- [b]Crash Fix[/b] – Addressed crash caused by spam-clicking at the end of a dialogue (reported by Bismuth).
- [b]UI Update[/b] – Changed Collection objective text from [i]“Eggs Found”[/i] to [i]“Golden Eggs Found”[/i] in both the Activity Result and Selection screens.

notes.title: Playtest Update Notes for Feb 28
notes.content:
- Fixed save game files issues, players should now be able to keep their progress.
- Fixed flowbreaker issu where holes in the floor near the elevator (HUB) would cause the player to stay stuck in a fall animation.
- Fixed flowbreaker issue with navmesh inside the first level that would cause enemies to jump down the map and out of sight.
